# ADR-043: Tool-call IDs are generated by Devo-K-Dev as nine random letters and digits; provider IDs are discarded

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Date:** 2026-10-26
- **Deciders:** Ved

## Decision

Tool-call IDs are generated by Devo-K-Dev as nine random letters and digits; provider IDs are discarded.

## Why

Mid-task handoff replays a conversation on another provider. Mistral accepts only nine alphanumeric characters; every other provider accepts any string. Generating IDs in the strictest format means no translation table is needed.

## Revisit if

A provider requires its own IDs to be echoed back.

## Details

See `src/devokdev/llm/messages.py`. Alternatives and trade-offs are in [`docs/learning/M1.md`](../learning/M1.md).
